intro: 1.7.2 is a round of fixes and polish after 1.7.1: a new page for Purify Plus, steadier reading on Android, pictures that arrive lighter and whole, and nine more books with covers.

sections.heading: Purify Plus, on a new page
sections.body: The Plus page is black and white now, with a scribe at the top. Every feature stands as a small poster in a row you can swipe through, and a tap opens it to say what it does, with the posters on either side a step away, so you can read them all in turn. The page names everything Plus opens, now with Ambience while you read and Remember a verse. When the yearly plan begins with a free week for you, the button says so. Your plan shows the same posters.

sections.heading: Steadier on Android
sections.body: The reading room's rows and a collection's passages no longer jump under your thumb as you scroll. The phone's back button closes the music player before it leaves the page. A verse you open from Continue stands out while the rest of the chapter steps back for two seconds, instead of a box drawn around every line.

sections.heading: Pictures that arrive whole
sections.body: Orthodox History's pictures are 41% smaller and show a soft preview until they have fully arrived, so none loads in pieces. The reading room's covers are 44% smaller. Nine more books have covers: St Mary of Egypt, St Augustine, St Theodosius the Great, the apostles James son of Zebedee, James son of Alphaeus, Jude, Simon and Matthias, and The Way of a Pilgrim.

sections.heading: And around the app
sections.body: In Your first Liturgy, Read it in Purify opens the Bible, a council or a Father's book on the very words quoted, and lights them for a moment. The buttons at the top are a size larger. Community's reactions sit in one quiet row. The chapter row in the Bible and the centuries in Orthodox History fade where there is more to see, and in the apps you feel a light click for each one that passes.
